subject: Tagging & consent coverage — request for evidence ahead of BrightEdge audit
body:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightedge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: TagOps Team <tagops@brightedge.com>, BrightEdge Legal <legal@brightedge.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tagging & consent coverage — upcoming audit evidence request

Hi Grace,

Hope you're doing well. We're running a vendor privacy audit for marketing tools next week and our compliance team asked for evidence of consent coverage and an inventory of tracking pixels on your public site (www.redwood-inference.com). Specifically they want:

- A map of tags fired via GTM with triggers (page, consent state, event)
- A CSV of all external pixels/requests including domain, purpose, and data collected
- A short statement on how consent is enforced (CMP integration, blocking, cookie banners)
- Any recent DPIA notes that reference marketing telemetry

Can you share these by Wednesday 04/14? If there are any sensitive internal docs we can accept redacted versions.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Privacy Program Manager | BrightEdge

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightedge.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tagging & consent coverage — upcoming audit evidence request

Hi Elaine — thanks for the heads up. We're able to provide a GTM tag map and an export of third-party requests. A couple quick clarifying Qs so we scope the deliverable correctly:

1) Do you need data-retention details for each vendor (how long cookies persist) or just the cookie name and purpose?
2) Is the auditor focusing only on the public marketing site or also on the docs.redwood-inference.com/docs (docs site) and our blog shortlinks?

We'll prepare:
- GTM visual tag map (PNG) showing container, triggers, and consent gating
- Pixel inventory CSV (domain, URL, cookie name, purpose, vendor, first-party/third-party)
- A short consent enforcement note that we can make auditor-friendly (1 page)
- DPIA excerpt if relevant

I'll loop Markus for the privacy-policy snippet and Neha for DPIA language.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

[Attachment: gtm-tag-map-2026-04-12.png (image/png)]
[Attachment: marketing-pixel-inventory-2026-04-12.csv (text/csv)]

---

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tagging & consent coverage — upcoming audit evidence request

Agree with Grace's plan — attaching a short privacy-policy snippet we can offer as an official statement to the auditor. It clarifies lawful basis (consent for marketing cookies), technical blocking behavior (GTM consentMode + CMP), and links to our data-retention matrix. Feel free to edit for tone.

Suggested statement (draft):
"We only load marketing/tracking tags after explicit consent is captured via our CMP. Tags managed in our GTM container are categorized and blocked by consent status using Consent Mode; we maintain an inventory mapping tags to vendors, purposes, and retention periods. For enterprise integrations that require server-side telemetry, we provide Data Processing Addenda and SCCs where applicable."

I'll also note that for EU visitors we fall under DPA/SCC obligations and we maintain vendor questionnaires for each vendor in our vendor risk tracker.

-Markus
VP, Legal & Compliance | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft-privacy-policy-snippet-2026-04-13.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 07:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tagging & consent coverage — upcoming audit evidence request

Quick DPIA / technical clarity:
- Our marketing telemetry DPIA (excerpt) notes that page-level tags do not include PII; only hashed identifiers are sent to analytics providers by default.
- We rely on the CMP vendor (Consently) which exposes an SDK to GTM for blocking until consent is present. The GTM container uses a consent trigger that prevents tag firing for marketing audiences.
- For server-side tags (used in some onboarding flows), we ensure PII is pseudonymized and covered under our DPA.

If the auditor needs the full DPIA we can provide a redacted excerpt; I recommend redaction of team-level contact emails.

-Neha
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Elaine Park <elaine@brightedge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightEdge Legal <legal@brightedge.com>, TagOps Team <tagops@brightedge.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tagging & consent coverage — upcoming audit evidence request

Hi Grace — this is great, thanks. A couple small follow-ups from our side:

- Please include cookie persistence (days) in the CSV if that's not too onerous.
- We only need the public marketing site for this round, not docs or blog.
- The auditor asked for a short note confirming whether any marketing tags ping vendor endpoints with hashed email identifiers (we have one vendor that does this via a hashed lookup).

Can you get the above by EOD Friday 04/16?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elaine

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@brightedge.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tagging & consent coverage — upcoming audit evidence request

Thanks Elaine — we'll add cookie persistence to the CSV and include the specific note on hashed identifiers.

Deliverables we will share by EOD 04/16:
- Updated pixel inventory CSV (includes cookie name, domain, purpose, retention days) [Attachment included]
- GTM tag map (PNG) showing consent triggers and blocked tag groups
- 1-page auditor statement (privacy-policy snippet + hashed-identifier note)
- Redacted DPIA excerpt (if auditor requests full DPIA)

I'll upload to the Drive link and send a DocuSign cover if BrightEdge Legal requires an attestation.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Security | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: updated-marketing-pixel-inventory-2026-04-15.csv (text/csv)]
